PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mechanical Properties of Materials? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mechanical Properties of Materials.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Electronics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Electronics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Electronics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Electronics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Electronics.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Moments and equilibrium? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Moments and equilibrium.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Moments and equilibrium.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Moments and equilibrium.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Moments and equilibrium.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Waves? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Waves.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Waves.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Waves.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Waves.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Temperature and Thermal Expansion? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Temperature and Thermal Expansion.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Temperature and Thermal Expansion.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Temperature and Thermal Expansion.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Temperature and Thermal Expansion.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 of 62 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
